message.content:
This appears to be a CBP ruling on a thermoelectric temperature control unit (chiller). The candidates are heading 8419 (machinery for temperature-change treatment of materials), heading 8418 (refrigerating equipment), and heading 9032 (automatic temperature regulating instruments).

Heading 8418 covers "other refrigerating or freezing equipment, electric or other; heat pumps." Subheading 8418.69 covers other refrigerating equipment, and 8418.69.01 is the likely 8-digit line. Thermoelectric (Peltier) chillers have been classified in 8418.69. The unit both heats and cools, so it functions as a heat pump or chiller in the 8418 sense. The remaining question is the 10-digit statistical suffix.

From memory, 8418.69.0120 is "Other: Liquid chillers" (formerly 8418.69.0100). I believe the current HTS structure is 8418.69.01 "Refrigerating or freezing equipment... Other", with 8418.69.0120 "Industrial process chillers"? I can't verify the exact suffix. I recall 8418.69.0190 as "Other", and I think 8418.69.01 is "Compression type" with 8418.69.0120 as "Other". Given the uncertainty, I will go with 8418.69.0190.

Heading 8419.89 is a plausible alternative, but I think 8418.69 fits better for a chiller that cools a circulating coolant.
